answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in fable and juniper recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 7 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the thread. A 484 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
